title: AI customer service: faster replies built on your own policies
seoTitle: AI customer service: replies from your policies
description: Set up AI customer service the safe way. Build a reply library from your policies, draft replies in your tone and know when a person must answer.
lede: AI customer service works best as a fast first draft, written from your own policies and reviewed by a person. This guide explains how to build a reply library and draft replies in your usual tone. It also shows which emails a human must answer, and how to check each reply before you send it.
keywords: AI customer support for small business
reply to customer emails with AI
